text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Boys were teasing a young girl about her 
dream of "becoming a princess one day"! As 
someone also striving to be a princess, I 
cannot let this slide!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This somehow reminds me of my childhood. 
Those days when I knocked on the doors of 
prestigious clubs wanting to become a 
princess, only to be repeatedly 
rejected...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, my weak heart has been CRUSHED to 
dust! Now my Trainer is right here with 
me! I shall show everyone what the 
strongest princess is made of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now, take my Princess☆Tackle— Wait, my 
body's moving all clumsy and I can't run 
properly! Just what in the world is going 
on here~~!?
